purpose: Machine-readable rule-specification foundation for CiteJury. EP-034 replaces the earlier OSCOLA-like helper with scoped, authority-backed OSCOLA outputs and registers non-implemented international authorities without claiming support.

rules.label: Supreme Court of India neutral citation
validation: sequence number must contain digits only
court, if supplied, must identify Supreme Court of India
formatting: token is year + INSC + sequence number with no inserted spaces
full output is case name, token
limitations: Does not verify that the sequence number belongs to the entered case
Does not cover High Court neutral citations
Does not add parallel citations or pinpoints
rules.nextEp: EP-036 for larger browser-only citation corpus

rules.label: Readable Indian judgment citation helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: Readable helper only; prefer the narrower SCI neutral, SCC, or AIR rules when applicable
Reporter-specific editorial requirements still require manual verification

rules.label: SCC law-report judgment citation scoped helper
limitations: Common core pattern only: case name, (year) volume SCC first page
Does not verify party names, parallel citations, pinpoints, supplement reports, or editorial variants
rules.nextEp: EP-036 for larger browser-only citation corpus

rules.label: AIR law-report judgment citation scoped helper
limitations: Common core pattern only: case name, AIR year court first page
Does not verify regional variations, parallel citations, pinpoints, or party names
rules.nextEp: EP-036 for larger browser-only citation corpus

rules.label: Readable legislation citation helper
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
limitations: Provision labels, chapter numbers, enactment numbers, jurisdiction, and amendments require future rule expansion.

rules.label: OSCOLA UK case citation scoped rule
validation: year must be four digits when supplied
neutral citation year must be bracketed if supplied
law report citations should include first page
formatting: neutral citation follows party names when supplied
law report follows neutral citation when supplied
court appears in parentheses only where no neutral citation is supplied
paragraph pinpoint appears in square brackets when supplied using volume field value prefixed with paragraph
limitations: Does not verify real case metadata
Does not handle every UK court/report series or bibliography behavior
Uses existing generic field names until EP-035 field-level explainability work
rules.nextEp: EP-036 for larger browser-only citation corpus

rules.label: OSCOLA UK legislation citation scoped rule
limitations: Basic Act/provision formatting only
Does not cover statutory instruments or complex legislative histories

rules.label: OSCOLA book citation scoped helper
limitations: Current field model combines author and title in title field and publisher details in reporter field
No separate author/editor/edition fields yet

rules.label: OSCOLA journal article scoped helper
limitations: Current field model combines author and article title in title field and volume/journal details in reporter field
No DOI, issue, article-title, or bibliography model yet

rules.label: AGLC Australian case citation authority registry
limitations: Registered for future implementation only; no public AGLC support claim yet
rules.nextEp: Future scoped EP after EP-040 or approved expansion

rules.label: Bluebook US case citation authority registry
limitations: Registered for future implementation only; no public Bluebook support claim yet
